title: Signed laws on Sierpinski tetrahedra and the exceptional angles
claim: On level-k Sierpinski d-simplices: (1) the cosine wave (-1)^(x_0) cos(theta E) reproduces itself when the number of up simplices C(k+d-1, d) is odd and becomes a multiple of the sine wave (-1)^(x_0) sin(theta E)/sin(theta) when it is even, for every d, k and all but finitely many theta per level; the parity twist exchanges the two families in even d and maps sine to sine (theta -> pi/2 - theta) in odd d, so the d = 2 law (-1)^a [NAE] of period 4 is the cosine wave at pi/6; (2) for d >= 2 and even k both waves vanish at theta = pi/4 (phase frustration along the edges between non-base corners), so y^2 - 2 divides the factor; (3) complement preserves exactness, and the non-base flip does at odd k for complement-(anti)invariant laws; (4) even parity is exact exactly at powers of 2 in every dimension, odd parity also needs d even (Lucas); (5) census of the 3,280 (d = 3, levels 2-5) and 29,524 (d = 4, levels 2-3) laws f(x_0, ones among the other corners) with weights in {-1, 0, 1}: 75 and 75 exact, 13 and 8 with knot support; every family law is exact exactly where its theorem allows except at listed zero factors; 6 and 2 sporadic knot laws; the knots exact at every computed level are exactly standing waves (sine pi/3 and pi/6 in d = 3; sine pi/3 and cosine pi/6 in d = 4); (6) the exceptional angles of the sine wave for d = 2 (k <= 8), 3 (k <= 5), 4 (k <= 3): rational ones only pi/2 and pi/4 (even k), all others irrational multiples of pi.
failure_conditions: An exact law of the census outside the stated families, or a family law not exact at a level where its family predicts.
A real root of a factor polynomial in (-2, 2) missing from the stated list of exceptional angles, or a listed angle at which the wave is exact.
A census law whose computed corner relation disagrees with brute-force enumeration on the small levels.
foundation_claim_scope: Signed (d+1)-bit laws symmetric in the non-base corners on level-k Sierpinski d-simplices (d = 3, 4; finite gadgets) and the standing wave's exceptional angles (d = 2, 3); exactness of the corner relation; the knot status of supports under K1-K3.

validation.status: checked: census engine against direct enumeration on 160 law-level pairs; full census recomputed exactly (int64, exact by the bound on summed vertices); every family law against its predicted levels with zero factors confirmed in floating point; Theorem 1 in floating point (60 cases, error below 1e-12 of the absolute sum) and in exact integers (cosine wave at pi/6, d = 2, k <= 8; d = 4, k <= 3); Theorem 2 by polynomial division and floating point; factorizations of the exact factor polynomials (six primes, stable under four); Theorem 4 in 36 cases; Lemma 3 on 54 flip instances; controls fire; proofs in proof.md; no human or external review
validation.novelty: no overlap found in the bounded search of SIMPLEX-GASKETS-20261029-001A (candidate local delta) for Theorems 1, 2, the census and Proposition 6; Lemma 3 elementary; Theorem 4 a direct extension of Lucas's theorem
